text: There have been a number of safety issues raised by both Toronto Fire Services and the condo management of 2800 Keele Street. The current parking restrictions do not prohibit vehicles from standing in places that result in many sightline issues and have resulted in a number of collisions and poses serious safety concerns. I am requesting that standing be prohibited on this section of Victory Drive.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the north side of Victory Drive, between Keele Street and a point 65 metres further west.
